in lovely forests, hermitages, mountain valleys, regions
discontent with the charming and pretty deer-fawn sports
slightly raised by play of a glance with lovely hint of laughter
looking with lovely sidelong glances, said this
the two roamed with the cries of creatures
whose mind's functions are restrained, the Self
streams of senses restrained, to Him as refuge
like the sun from fear of Rudra
in a mud of floods of blood

shame the upper, the lip the lower
from dissolution, origin and so on of this
jewel among women, whose glorious feet are unseen, unserved

graceful gait, play, lovely laughter and affection, glances, great honour
lovely, seated on the assembly seat
by gracious generous smile and play of glances

permitted, having obtained boons from elders
